Polish README and replace demo outputs with real agent responses

- Fix git clone URL to match actual repo name (NeuroUI-Agent)

Initial commit: NeuroUI Agent with tool-use architecture

LLM agent that recommends accessible UI components for neurodivergent
users using Claude API tool-use pattern. Searches 15 real NeuroUI
components, references cognitive science guidelines for 5 conditions
(ADHD, autism, dyslexia, sensory sensitivity, motor impairment),
and generates ready-to-use code with reasoning.

G3 Edit 1: Full UI spec overhaul — nav, discovery, cards, chats, interactions

- Redesign nav: EASEA logo, underline tabs (Discovery/My Group/Chats/Profile), avatar menu
- Discovery: toggle chips + popover filters, responsive 4-col card grid, sort control
- People cards: shadow/hover spec, skills max 3, overlap progress bar, status pills
- Groups cards: member count pill, skills needed, overlap bar
- Detail panel: status pill, all skills section, bio section, request sent/withdraw state
- 3-panel Chats page: conversation list with tabs, system card as chat bubble, decline flow, vertical timeline, group chat with pinned top position
- Notification: 22px bell, 6px dot, 360px dropdown, spec shadows
- My Group: empty state, forming status line, confirm dialog, leave as text link
- Card interactions: star always visible with SVG + localStorage, eye visibility toggle with confirm dialog + gray-out + individual restore
- All emoji replaced with SVG icons (17 new icons)
- Design tokens: Plus Jakarta Sans font, #F9FAFB bg, #111827 text, #E5E7EB borders
- Status rename: searching→solo, forming→open-group, grouped→closed
- Demo bar: separated from content (flex layout, no overlap)

Adjust semantic color values for better visibility

Tune success, warning, danger, and caution OKLCH values to be
more distinguishable against the white card background.

Apply score-based tier colors to Board card sidebar strips

Board cards now use compatScore thresholds (>=80 green, >=50 yellow,
<50 red) for the left sidebar background, overlap text, and score
badge, replacing the old overlap-only (0h = red, else green) logic.
Fix ProfilePage tier threshold to match Board routing (>=80 for good)

Unify ProfileView and SnapWarn into single parameterized ProfilePage

Replace two separate profile components with one tier-aware ProfilePage
that renders good/normal/bad variants based on compatibility score.
Adds three routes (profile-view-good, profile-view-normal, profile-view-bad)
and updates all cross-references in Board, Chat, and Urgent pages.

Apply pure B/W theme, fix select dropdowns, and unify layout

- Replace color system with zero-chroma OKLCH black/white theme
- Add full dark mode (.dark) CSS variables
- Set background to #FCFCFC (oklch 0.99), cards to pure white
- Convert all blue/hex hardcoded colors to theme tokens
- Map semantic colors (success/warning/caution) to grayscale
- Fix SelectContent default to position="popper" (floating dropdown)
- Unify Prof0 width to 680px matching Prof1–3
- Normalize button sizes across chat, profile, and group pages
- Add scrollbar-gutter: stable to prevent layout shift

Reduce verbose text and add color-coded skill proficiency pills

- Replace plain-text skill proficiency with color-coded pill badges
  (Expert=green, Proficient=blue, Intermediate=yellow, Beginner=gray)
- Trim helper text across all pages for scannability
- Remove redundant matchReasons/warnings from ProfileView score card
- Remove duplicate Availability card (schedule grid already shows this)
- Remove duplicate View Compatibility button from Chat

Migrate color system from hex to OKLCH for dark mode readiness

- Convert all 30+ hex custom properties in index.css to oklch() values
- Add color primitives (--hue-*, --chroma-*) enabling lightness-only dark mode
- Deduplicate sidebar/chart/gray tokens with var() references to core palette
- Replace 15 hardcoded hex values in App.tsx with CSS variable references
- Register new --icon-default, --schedule-self, --schedule-other in @theme

Implement convergent UX design across all 5 requirements (7.1–7.5)

Phase 1 (7.1): Centralized discovery dashboard with working filters,
sort, search, activity indicators, 12 students, and empty state.

Phase 2 (7.2): Pre-commitment compatibility assessment with numerical
scores, sub-score bars, match reasons, and skill complementarity grids
on ProfileView, SnapGood, and SnapWarn pages.

Phase 3 (7.3): Seamless post-match transition with contact exchange,
project board, group availability in MyGroup; quick actions in Chat;
group conversation in Inbox.

Phase 4 (7.5): Admin visibility via tabbed TADash with overview
analytics, formation timeline, section breakdown, skill supply/demand,
filterable student roster, and at-risk student alerts.

Phase 5 (7.4): Deadline pressure automation with escalation tiers,
progress bar, provisional group formation on Urgent page, and
tier-aware banner controls on Board.

Center SVG icons and improve UI/UX polish across all pages

- Center email icon on Verify page and books icon on Dashboard
  empty state using flex justify-center
- Style checkmark confirmations (Sent, ProfDone) with circular
  green background instead of raw text emoji
- Add scroll-to-top on all page navigations
- Add hover states + transitions to role cards, course card,
  inbox conversation cards, and urgent banner
- Add hover/transition feedback to skill tags, platform toggles,
  proficiency buttons, and time grid cells
- Fix "D-3" → "3 days left" on board urgent banner for consistency
- Add missing mb-3.5 spacing on ProfileView compatibility card

Fix GitHub Pages deployment to push to gh-pages branch

The repo's Pages source is configured to deploy from the gh-pages
branch, not GitHub Actions. Switch from actions/deploy-pages to
peaceiris/actions-gh-pages which pushes built assets to gh-pages.

Implement 28 UX/UI fixes from demo review + migrate to TypeScript

P0 (critical): Fix hardcoded "Jesse" in Sent page with dynamic targetName
prop, add separate Login page, visually distinguish demo toggle controls,
add Copy button handler with clipboard API, add Ask TA handler.

P1 (usability): Add AM/PM labels to time grids, fix opacity-40 readability
on confirmed students, demote duplicate CTA, add progress bar step labels,
add card hover states, rename Group Chat to Messages, standardize nav.

P2 (accessibility): Convert interactive spans/divs to buttons with ARIA
roles, link form labels to inputs via htmlFor/id, add icon indicators
alongside color, add sr-only text for unread dots, wrap checkbox in label.

P3 (content): Simplify "Get Started" CTA, use professional proficiency
levels, quantify skill coverage metric, fix placeholder spoiler, clarify
deadline format, add password mismatch error state.

P4 (polish): Add landing page footer, change unread dot to blue, add
profile completion confirmation screen, add sr-only CSS utility.
